Mosaic’s latest update hit a market that had already been cautious, yet the stock has surged recently. items.title: Mosaic (MOS) Stock May Be Undervalued As Recovery Plans Take Shape
items.summary: Mosaic has just logged a sharp short term rebound in its share price, even as its longer term returns remain weak. With the business working through operational and financing changes, the question is how much revenue investors are really paying for today.
